sources.sourceText:
Congrats on 5,650 subscribers 🎉🎉🎉 I'm glad you reached your goal and I'm very proud of Mio-chan for all her hard work. Your singing today was so beautiful that I wish I could let the whole world hear it. 👏👏👏👏👏 Such a soothing and clear voice.

1:04:50 Also, I wasn't able to say it earlier since I had to leave the room for a moment, but the subtitles definitely translated this as "psycho." :_草ｗｗｗ::_草ｗｗｗ::_草ｗｗｗ:But don't worry, I'm always paying attention to context when I'm reading the translation. I try not to comment or explain to other viewers without being somewhat confident in the meaning. I also translate the live chat, so thanks to all the other listeners for helping me understand Mio-chan's words. I'll keep using it responsibly until I learn proper Japanese (I'm still at a baby's level.)

Speaking of which, the guy who was asking you why you were so happy at 42:00 was pretty much just trolling/joking around. I think he was trying to get you to show an angry expression or something, but his language started coming across a bit strong/pushy even in English. Most of the time overseas listeners just come in and call you cute though, so be at ease. 👍
